_comment: TODO: replace every device_id below with the real ROM id from `ls /sys/bus/w1/devices` on the Pi. All 15 device_id values below are IDENTICAL PLACEHOLDERS - DS18B20s have no address pins, so wire and read one probe at a time, label it, and fill in its unique ROM id here before moving to the next. Leaving duplicates in place will make every probe read the same value.
_comment_bus: REVERTED 2026-09-13: single bus on GPIO2 (physical pin 3), not the earlier 3-bus GPIO4/17/27 split - confirmed by the Delhi engineer's schematic, which uses GPIO2's built-in 1.8kOhm I2C pull-up resistor for 1-Wire (no external resistor needed). This means the 20x4 I2C LCD (BOM #34) CANNOT be used at the same time (GPIO2/3 is the I2C bus) - confirmed unused for this build. See edge/DEPLOY.md.
